acquisition_method.evidence: The analysis was conducted using an Easy-nLC 1000 liquid chromatograph (Thermo Scientific) coupled to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) equipped with a FAIMS Pro interface (Thermo). Compensation voltages of -50 and -70 were used.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were reduced with DTT and alkylated with iodoacetamide.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Prior to trypsin digestion (1:30 ratio), the alkylation was quenched with DTT and urea diluted using ammonium bicarbonate.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Ions with charge >+2 were selected for HCD fragmentation using an isolation window of 1.6  m/z, dynamic exclusion window of 30 s, and 10 ppm mass tolerance.
